notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
easyPrerequisites: You've discarded at least one card this turn.
description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Living Laser as attackers.
Living Laser triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.name: Bruce Banner // The Incredible Hulk
uses.cardState: as The Incredible Hulk and without summoning sickness
